Frequently asked questions

Important details before you begin.

Does ClarityGrid file every transportation report?

Filing responsibility depends on engagement scope, state, authority type and source-data readiness. The proposal identifies what ClarityGrid prepares, files or coordinates.

Can you reconcile factoring activity?

Yes. The workflow can separate gross freight revenue, factoring fees, reserves, chargebacks and net deposits when supporting records are available.
